summary: A day driven by Reliance's blockbuster Jio IPO momentum and retail sector dynamics. Jio Platforms plans October 21 IPO launch while DailyObjects raises Rs 332 crore for expansion; separately, festive shoppers show 70% impulse purchase rates.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms plans IPO launch on October 21, with Ambani heirs facing roadshow questions on record offering.
DailyObjects raises Rs 332 crore in Series C funding; plans 150 new stores over five years.
Google study: 9 in 10 festive shoppers research extensively; 70 percent make impulse purchases.
Delhi High Court refuses urgent hearing in Youth Congress petition for Jantar Mantar protest permission against CEC.
US seizes seven internet domains to disrupt hacking infrastructure run by China's Integrity Tech Group.
